Message: Lady Elfriede is the reason I live.

From the moment she took me in,
my life became hers.

Thus, I made the decision to
spend my life serving her.
But...

The entire time,
Lady Elfriede was under
the control of a demon.

All I did was carry on,
unaware of the truth,
executing one order
after another...

She was my savior...
Yet, instead of saving her
in return, I only caused her
more pain...!

...I know.
Nothing I do can
change the past.
That’s why I swear
this new oath to you.

From this day forth,
I will do everything
in my power to protect you.

Even if being protected is
not what you wish for...
